remarks: A thoughtfully updated townhouse-style condo offering exceptional value, efficiency improvements, and modern living in one of New Canaan's most convenient and desirable communities. Ideally located just moments from downtown New Canaan, this 3-bedroom residence combines comfortable living spaces filled with natural light. The home features an inviting open-concept main level, spacious bedrooms, private outdoor space, and a heated lower-level area is ideal for a home office, media room, fitness gym, or other flex living space. Recent improvements include a newly insulated attic designed to support enhanced year-round comfort and energy efficiency as well as landscape improvements for outdoor enjoyment. The home is wired for high-speed internet, making it exceptionally well-suited for modern remote work-at-home and streaming needs. Additional highlights include relatively low property taxes and low HOA when compared to many surrounding Fairfield County communities, and a low-maintenance lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to New Canaan's highly regarded public schools, along with the town's vibrant downtown, parks, dining, library, shopping, and commuter convenience to downtown Stamford and New York City. This is a rare opportunity to own a proactively maintained home offering efficiency upgrades, flexibility, and long-term value.
